\begin{lemma}[The squares' certificate]\label{lem:cornercert}
At two directions or beyond, at the square window's data
(Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}) and the scale $\eta$
(Lemma~\ref{lem:corner}), the \emph{squares' certificate} reads the
window's pencil at the dual representative as the certificate's
squares' fold joined to a multiplication $\zeta$
(Construction~\ref{con:coeff}), at three reads. \emph{(i) The local
square.} The certificate's fluxes' fold collects at the kernel
identity to the plaquettes' gradient squares against the off-range
residual,
\[
2\kappa_\Sigma\sum_{\ell,a}G_{\ell a}^{2}
+\big|\,v+(\Pi\,v)^{\!\vee}\big|^{2}
\;=\;\sum_p\sum_a\big(X_a\chi_p\big)^{2}
\qquad\text{at}\quad v:=\big(R_{0\leftarrow p}\nabla\chi_p\big)_p\ ,
\]
the second summand the self-pairing of the fluxes moved to one
vertex off the incidence's range, at or beyond the sum's unit at
the positive pairing. \emph{(ii) The cross read.} At a plaquette
$p$ and a link $\ell$ the generators' trace of the moved gradient
reads the Casimir-weighted character's balance partner joined to the
\emph{deviation} at a boundary link and the sum's unit at every
further link,
\begin{gather*}
\sum_aX_a^{\ell}\big(R_{\ell\leftarrow p}\nabla\chi_p\big)_a
\;=\;K_{p\ell}\,\big\langle\,\mathrm{dev}_{\ell p}\!:\!\chi'_p\,\big\rangle
\quad\text{at}\ \ \ell\in\partial p\ ,\\
\mathrm{dev}_{\ell p}:=\sum_{a,b}
\big\langle\mathrm{Hol}_{\ell p}\!:\!1\big\rangle_{ab}\,
\big(\nabla^{2}_{\ell p}\big)_{ab}\ ,
\end{gather*}
each deviation and its balance partner at or below
$m_L\,(\delta_p+\delta_{\mathrm{Hol}})$ at the loop's adjoint
deficit; folded at the certificate's fluxes, the divergence
(Construction~\ref{con:coeff}) reads the kernel's diagonal against
the Casimir-weighted characters joined to the deviations,
\[
\sum_{\ell,a}X_a^{\ell}(G_{\ell a})
\;=\;\Big\langle\,\sum_p\sum_{\ell\in\partial p}
K_{p\ell}\,(K^{\mathsf T}\mathsf S)_{\ell p}\,\mathrm{dev}_{\ell p}
\;:\;\sum_pD_p\,\chi'_p\,\Big\rangle\ ,
\]
the deviations' weighted fold over the plaquettes and their
boundary links at or below $\Omega\sum_q\delta_q$ at the covering
count. \emph{(iii) The floor line.} $\zeta$ sits at or beyond the
\emph{floor line}: at the deficits $\delta_p$ at the closure's
dimension fold (Lemma~\ref{lem:loopcap}), the kernel's diagonal $D_p$ per
plaquette, a tower element between the sum's unit and $D_+=2g$, the
covering count $\Omega$, a pair, the closure's largest Casimir
$C_2^{+}$ and its dimension-weighted mean $c_L$ at $c_L\,d_L=K_L$,
the Casimir fold $\sum_{\lambda\in\bar L}C_2(\lambda)\,d_\lambda$,
\begin{gather*}
\zeta\;\ge\;\sum_p[\,1:2d_L\,]\,
\big\langle\delta_p\!:\!\eta\,d_L\,(C_2^{+}D_p+\Omega)\big\rangle^{2}
+\ell_0\ ,\\
\ell_0:=\sum_pd_L\,\Big\langle\eta\,c_LD_p\;:\;
1+[\,1:2\,]\,\eta^{2}\,(C_2^{+}D_p+\Omega)^{2}\Big\rangle\ ,
\end{gather*}
the \emph{floor line}, a tower element, the window's pencil at or
beyond it over the window's tower (Lemma~\ref{lem:inertia} at the
located stage): the ground sits at or beyond $\ell_0$, the kernel's
read $\eta\,K_L\sum_pD_p$ against the flat read $d_L\,\#p$, the
loss the scale's square against the count at the covering count's
square.

The certificate's data are the window's

from the one base to the other, the link's own path backtracking

read.} The divergence $\sum_{\ell,a}X_a^{\ell}(G_{\ell a})$

balance partner each sit at or below
$[\,1:2\,]\,h_L\,|E|^{2}=h_L\,\delta_{\mathrm{Hol}}$: the deviation at
$(p,\ell)$ and its balance partner each sit at or below
$m_L\,(\delta_p+\delta_{\mathrm{Hol}})$ at the deviation pair $m_L$. Folded over the
plaquettes and their boundary links the deviation sits within
$\Omega\sum_q\delta_q$ at the loop deficits' cap and the covering
count (Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}). And the square completes at
the scale, the weighted deficit read at the largest Casimir,
$\delta'_p\le C_2^{+}\delta_p$,
\begin{gather*}
\zeta\;\ge\;\sum_p[\,1:2d_L\,]\,
\big\langle\delta_p\!:\!\eta\,d_L\,(C_2^{+}D_p+\Omega)\big\rangle^{2}
+\ell_0\ ,\\
\ell_0:=\sum_pd_L\,\Big\langle\eta\,c_LD_p\;:\;
1+[\,1:2\,]\,\eta^{2}\,(C_2^{+}D_p+\Omega)^{2}\Big\rangle
\qquad\text{at}\quad c_L\,d_L=K_L\ ,
\end{gather*}
the \emph{floor line}, the window's pencil at or beyond it: the
ground sits at or beyond $\ell_0$, the kernel's read
$\eta\,K_L\sum_pD_p$ against the flat read $d_L\,\#p$, the loss the
scale's square against the count at the covering count's square.
\end{proof}
\end{lemma}

\begin{construction}[The corner trial]\label{con:cornertrial}
At the square window's data (Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}),
the scale $\eta=[\,n:s\,]$ at or below one and a stated pair
$\varepsilon$ at or below one, the \emph{mass}, the trial's data are
the reads below, $D$ the deficits' fold
(Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}). \emph{The exponent} is the balance partner of the
kernel's form at the moved fluxes joined to the mass's multiple of
the deficits' fold,
\[
\Phi\;:=\;\Big\langle\,[\,1:2\kappa_\Sigma\,]\sum_{p,q}
\mathsf S_{pq}\,D_{pq}+\varepsilon\,D\Big\rangle^{\!\vee}\ ,
\qquad
\Phi_+:=(L+2\,\varepsilon)\,d_L\,\#p\ ,
\]
at or below the sum's unit and at or beyond the balance partner of
$\Phi_+$: the form is the fold over the generator index of the
kernel's form at the lists $(f_p)_a$, a fold of squares at the
blocks' coefficients $w_K$, each at or beyond the sum's unit and at
or below the roots' floor $[\,L:2\,]$, so the form sits between the
sum's unit and $[\,L:2\,]$ times the lists' self-pairing, at or
below $[\,L:2\,]\sum_p2\kappa_\Sigma\,\delta_p$ at the gradient
deficit (Lemma~\ref{lem:loopcap}), and the deficits' fold at or
below $2d_L\,\#p$. The two summands read the sum's unit at distinct
configurations: the kernel's form reads it exactly where every moved
flux does, and a plaquette's flux reads it at every coefficient
whose adjoint block is symmetric at the orthogonal read, the
gradient's trace pairing an antisymmetric generator against a
symmetric matrix, while the deficit there reads half the fold of
squares of $1-R$ at the joined coefficient
(Lemma~\ref{lem:loopcap}), occupied off the identity; the deficits'
fold reads the sum's unit at the flat configurations alone, so the
mass fixes the trial's weight at the flat configurations at every
scale below the pair's own, its mismatch against the kernel's form
at the modes priced at the cap. \emph{The near data.} At the
count reads $A$, $\wp$ of Lemma~\ref{lem:contactdrift}, the
\emph{support exponent} $e:=(3\wp+1)\,\#\ell$ and the \emph{support
coefficient} $c_W:=A^{3\#\ell}(9g)^{e}$, the natural $j:=e+1$, the
pair $\tau:=[\,n:4\,d_L\,\#p\,(L+2\varepsilon)\,s\,]$ and the
\emph{concentration key} $k:=k(\tau)$, the least natural at
$k\,\tau^{\,j}\ge c_W\,j^{\,j}$, its witness the division's quotient
of $c_W\,j^{\,j}\,b^{\,j}$ at $a^{\,j}$ at its successor at
$\tau=[\,a:b\,]$ (Definition~\ref{def:ground}), the \emph{near mass} is
the pair $\vartheta:=[\,1:2\,c_W\,k^{e}\,]$, one read of the scale,
the side and the mass. The \emph{mode square} is $Q:=|y_W|^{2}$,
the mode coordinate's self-pairing at the profile
(Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}), a positive element, with its
\emph{pairs}
\[
Q_+:=4\,\kappa_\Sigma\,d_L\,\#p\,|W|^{2}\ ,\qquad
Q_-:=\eta\,\kappa_\Sigma\dim G\,|W|^{2}\,\vartheta\,[\,1:4\,(L+2)\,]\ ;
\]
the \emph{stated weight pairs} are the unit's $(1,\vartheta)$, the
mode square's $(Q_+,Q_-)$ and its square's $(Q_+^{2},Q_-^{2})$; the
\emph{bit count} $j'$ is the largest, over the three pairs
$(P_+,P_-)$ and the powers $k$ at or below four, of the least
natural at or beyond one at $2^{j'}\ge P_+\,[\,1:\varepsilon^{k}P_-\,]$,
one trichotomy fold, each least natural the stepping read by halving
from one at the witness the compared pair's first member
(Definition~\ref{def:ground}); and the \emph{near scale} is
$K:=[\,48\,(4+j'):\varepsilon\,]$. \emph{The exponent count.} The
natural $m$ is the larger of the division's quotient of
$2\,(L+2)\,d_L\,\#p\,s\,s$ at $n\,n$ at its successor and $4+j'$, one
trichotomy fold (Definition~\ref{def:ground}), so $m$ sits at or
beyond $2\,\Phi_+\,s\,s$ against $n\,n$ at the mass at or below one
and at or beyond $4+j'$. \emph{The trial.} The
\emph{trial's factor} and the \emph{trial} are
\[
B\;:=\;1+\Phi\,[\,s:n\,m\,]\ ,
\qquad
\Psi\;:=\;B^{\,m}\ ,
\]
$B$ a multiplication between $[\,1:2\,]$ and one, the exponent's
read against the scale's multiple of $m$ at or below one half
($\Phi_+\,[\,s:n\,m\,]\le[\,n:2s\,]\le[\,1:2\,]$ at the scale at or
below one), so $\Psi$ sits between $[\,1:2\,]^{m}$ and one, positive
by its shape; the generators read it at the powers' Leibniz read,
$X_a^{\ell}\Psi=m\,B^{\,m-1}\,X_a^{\ell}B$, so
\[
B\;X_a^{\ell}\Psi\;=\;[\,s:n\,]\,\big(X_a^{\ell}\Phi\big)\,\Psi\ ,
\]
one exact identity per link and generator. \emph{The moment
reads.} At a carrier element $F$ the \emph{moment reads} are
$\mu[F]:=\mathrm{Eval}(F\,\Psi^{2})$ and
$\nu[F]:=\mathrm{Eval}(F\,B^{\,2m-1})$, the trial's square with one
factor $B$ withdrawn, tower elements at the tower's own evaluation,
the evaluation additive and scale-reading in the coefficients; a
\emph{weight} is a positive element $P$ at or below $P_+$, a
comparison of elements, with its moment $\mu[P]$ at or beyond $P_-$
at one of the stated weight pairs, and a weight's square is a weight
at the squared pair, $P^{2}$ at or below $P_+^{2}$ at the two gaps'
product and $\mu[P^{2}]\,\mu[1]\ge\mu[P]^{2}$ at $\mu[1]\le1$ (the
evaluation's squared Cauchy--Schwarz; $\Psi^{2}\le\Psi\le1$ at the
factor between $[\,1:2\,]$ and one); the
parts identity at the product $F\,\Psi^{2}$
(Construction~\ref{con:coeff}) with the identity above reads
\[
\mu\big[X_a^{\ell}F\big]+2\,[\,s:n\,]\,\nu\big[F\,X_a^{\ell}\Phi\big]
\;=\;0\ ,
\qquad
\mu[F]=\nu[F]+[\,s:n\,m\,]\,\nu[F\,\Phi]\ ,
\]
the \emph{parts identity at the trial} and the \emph{factor's
display}, the second the square's split at one factor; at the
exponent count the exponent's read against the scale's multiple of
$m$ sits at or below half the scale,
$\Phi_+\,[\,s:n\,m\,]\le[\,n:2s\,]$, so at a \emph{cap} of a member
$F$, a positive element $F_+$ with $F_++F$ and $F_++F^{\vee}$
positive elements, each of $\mu[F]-\nu[F]$ and its balance partner
sits at or below $[\,n:2s\,]\,\nu[F_+]$ (the read $\nu[F\,\Phi]$ at
$\Phi$ the balance partner of the positive $|\Phi|$ at or below
$\Phi_+$), and at a positive element $F$ the two reads are ordered,
$\langle1\!:\![\,n:2s\,]\rangle\,\nu[F]\le\mu[F]\le\nu[F]$, with
$\nu[F]\le2\,\mu[F]$ at the scale at or below one. \emph{The deviation.} The
exponent's gradient reads the certificate's fluxes, the \emph{mass
gradient} and a deviation quadratic in the fluxes,
$X_a^{\ell}\Phi=G_{\ell a}+\varepsilon\,F_{\ell a}+R_{\ell a}$ at
$F_{\ell a}:=\sum_{p\ni\ell}K_{p\ell}\,(R_{\ell\leftarrow0}f_p)_a$,
the link's plaquettes' moved fluxes at the traversal signs
(Lemma~\ref{lem:loopcap}'s gradient move), its square fold at or
below the link's plaquette count $2g$ against the fluxes' squares
(Construction~\ref{con:coeff}'s Cauchy--Schwarz at the count): a
generator at a link reads a moved flux at three sites, the boundary
read $X_a^{\ell}\nabla\chi_p=K_{p\ell}\,\nabla^{2}_{\ell p}$ at
$\ell\in\partial p$, the second gradient at the arc
(Proposition~\ref{prop:lap}'s joint insertion), whose read is the
count's balance partner at the arc's coefficient joined to a
remainder, $\nabla^{2}_{\ell p}=\langle\,E_{\ell p}:\kappa_\Sigma\,
R_{\mathrm{arc}}\rangle$ at the remainder's fold
$\sum_{a,b}(E_{\ell p})_{ab}^{2}\le2\,h_L^{\,2}\,\delta_p$
(the second gradient at the loop's coefficient,
Lemma~\ref{lem:casimir}'s block read at the trace read's one value
at the moved list (Lemma~\ref{lem:lowerspan}), the
second-gradient cap
against $\langle\mathrm{Hol}\!:\!1\rangle$'s fold $2\delta_p$ by
Construction~\ref{con:coeff}'s Cauchy--Schwarz); the transport read
at a link of the root path, the generator inserted at the link's
tail in the path word,
$X_a^{\ell}R_{0\leftarrow p}=\mathrm{ad}(R_{0\leftarrow\ell}X_a)\,
R_{0\leftarrow p}$, its fold over the generator index the adjoint
Casimir's read $\kappa_\theta$ against the flux's self-pairing (the
moved list $R_{0\leftarrow\ell}X_a$ orthonormal at the adjoint
coefficient's evaluation identity, the Casimir one operator at every
orthonormal list, Definition~\ref{def:generators}); and the arc's
coefficient against the tree path's, the loop's own,
$R_{0\leftarrow p}R_{\mathrm{arc}}=R_{0\leftarrow\ell}\,\mathrm{Hol}_{\ell p}$
at the loop (Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}). Folded at
the kernel the generator's read of the exponent collects the
certificate's flux, the loop's coefficient against the identity,
the remainder and the transport,
\begin{multline*}
R_{\ell a}\;=\;\sum_{p\ni\ell}K_{p\ell}\sum_q\mathsf S_{pq}\,
\big\langle R_{0\leftarrow\ell}\langle\mathrm{Hol}_{\ell p}\!:\!1\rangle e_a,\,f_q\big\rangle
+[\,1:\kappa_\Sigma\,]\sum_{p\ni\ell}K_{p\ell}\sum_q\mathsf S_{pq}\,
\big\langle R_{0\leftarrow p}E_{\ell p}\,e_a,\,f_q\big\rangle^{\!\vee}\\
+[\,1:\kappa_\Sigma\,]\sum_{p:\ \ell\in\text{path}(p)}\sum_q\mathsf S_{pq}\,
\big\langle\mathrm{ad}(R_{0\leftarrow\ell}X_a)f_p,\,f_q\big\rangle^{\!\vee}\ ,
\end{multline*}
the last fold over the plaquettes whose root path holds $\ell$,
each summand a product of two flux-order reads, the first at the
loop's deficit, the second at the remainder's fold and the third at
the adjoint index's, at $(\mathsf Sf)_p:=\sum_q\mathsf S_{pq}f_q$:
the deviation's square fold over the links and the generator index
reads the three members' squares at three folds
(Construction~\ref{con:coeff}'s Cauchy--Schwarz at the counts, at
most $2g$ boundary plaquettes per link and at most $\#p$ plaquettes
whose root path holds the link), the first at the loop's Frobenius
read
$\sum_{a,b}\langle\mathrm{Hol}\!:\!1\rangle_{ab}^{2}=2\,\delta_{\mathrm{Hol}}$
(the unitary read), the second at the remainder's fold
$2h_L^{2}\delta_p$ and the third at the adjoint index
$\kappa_\theta$, the transport read's fold, each
against $|(\mathsf Sf)_p|^{2}$. The kernel's square reads at the
blocks, $\sum_p|(\mathsf Sf)_p|^{2}=\sum_a\sum_Kw_K^{2}\,|\Pi_Kf_a|^{2}$
at $f_a$ the list $(f_{p})_a$ over the plaquettes and the blocks'
orthogonality, each block's coefficient at or below the roots'
floor's square $[\,L^{2}:4\,]$ and the blocks' folds' sum
$|\Pi f_a|^{2}$ at or below $|f_a|^{2}$, the range and kernel parts'
squares, so
$\sum_p|(\mathsf Sf)_p|^{2}\le[\,L^{2}:4\,]\sum_p|f_p|^{2}
\le[\,L^{2}:4\,]\,2\kappa_\Sigma D$; the boundary pairs fold at four
links per plaquette with the loop deficits at
$\delta_{\mathrm{Hol}}\le t_L\,gL\,D$ (the loop's cap,
Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}), and the path pairs
fold at the root paths' lengths, at most $(g+1)\,L$ links each, so
the third fold's count is the length against the plaquette count:
\[
\sum_{\ell,a}R_{\ell a}^{2}\ \le\ \Theta_R\,D^{2}\ ,
\qquad
\Theta_R:=24\,t_L\,\kappa_\Sigma\,g^{2}L^{3}+24\,g\,h_L^{2}L^{2}
+3\,(g+1)\,\kappa_\theta\,\#p\,L^{3}\ ,
\]
the \emph{deviation's pair}, in the side and the plaquette count,
with $T_R:=1+\Theta_R$ its successor at $\Theta_R\le T_R^{2}$; at a
positive pair $t$ and a list $x$ over the generator index the
pairing against a link's deviation and its balance partner each sit
at or below the two-member square's read,
\[
2\,\langle x,R_\ell\rangle\ \le\ [\,1:t\,]\,|x|^{2}+t\sum_aR_{\ell a}^{2}\ ,
\]
the gap the fold of squares
$[\,1:t\,]\sum_a\langle x_a\!:\!t\,R_{\ell a}\rangle^{2}$ and at the
balance partner the fold at the swapped members.
\end{construction}

\begin{lemma}[The near reads]\label{lem:cornernear}
At the corner trial (Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}) three reads
hold at every scale at or below one. \emph{(i) The far and near
reads.} At $x:=|\Phi|\,[\,s:n\,m\,]$ and a natural $j$ at or below
$m$, the comparisons of positive elements
\[
C(2m,j)\,x^{j}\,\Psi^{2}\ \le\ 1\ ,\qquad
\Psi^{2}\,(\varepsilon\,D)^{j}\ \le\ j!\ \eta^{\,j}\ ,\qquad
\Psi^{2}\ \ge\ 1-2m\,x\quad\text{at}\quad 2m\,x=2\,|\Phi|\,[\,s:n\,]\ .
\]
\emph{(ii) The near mass.} At the near mass $\vartheta$
(Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}),
\[
\mu[1]\ \ge\ \vartheta\ .
\]
\emph{(iii) The near scale.} At a weight $P$ at one of the stated
weight pairs, a power $k$ at or below four and the near scale $K$
(Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}),
\[
\mu\big[P\,D^{k}\big]\ \le\ 2\,(K\eta)^{k}\,\mu[P]\ .
\]
\begin{proof}
\emph{The positive reads.} The deficit and its complement are folds
of squares, $2\,\delta_p$ and $2\,(2d_L-\delta_p)$ the
self-pairings of $1-R$ and $1+R$ at the plaquette's joined
coefficient (Lemma~\ref{lem:loopcap};
Construction~\ref{con:coeff}'s evaluation identity), so the
exponent's balance partner $|\Phi|$, the kernel's form joined to
the mass's fold, is a positive element with $\Phi_+$ at or beyond
it at three positive gaps, the roots' floor at the kernel's form
($[\,L:2\,]$ against each $w_K$ at the blocks' squares), the
gradient deficit's spare, the projection residual's fold of
squares (Lemma~\ref{lem:loopcap}), and the deficits' complements.
So at $x:=|\Phi|\,[\,s:n\,m\,]$ the trial reads
$\Psi^{2}=(1-x)^{2m}$ at the positive elements $x$ and $1-x$, the
latter the pair $1-\Phi_+[\,s:n\,m\,]$, at or beyond $[\,1:2\,]$,
joined to $(\Phi_+-|\Phi|)\,[\,s:n\,m\,]$. Two reads at the
binomial partition $1=\sum_iC(2m,i)\,x^{i}(1-x)^{2m-i}$, every
summand positive. The \emph{far read}: at a natural $j$ at or
below $m$,
\[
C(2m,j)\,x^{j}\,\Psi^{2}\ \le\ 1\ ,
\qquad
\Psi^{2}\,(\varepsilon\,D)^{j}\ \le\ j!\ \eta^{\,j}\ ,
\]
the first the partition's further summands joined to the $j$-th
summand's read against $(1-x)^{j}$, the gap
$x\sum_{i<j}(1-x)^{i}$ at the telescope
$(1-x)^{i}=1-x\sum_{i'<i}(1-x)^{i'}$, and the second at
$\varepsilon D\le|\Phi|$ with $j!\,C(2m,j)\ge m^{j}$ at $j\le m$:
the evaluation of a positive element against
$\Psi^{2}(\varepsilon D)^{j}$ sits at or below $j!\,\eta^{j}$
against its own evaluation. The \emph{near read}:
$\Psi^{2}\ge1-2m\,x$, the gap
$x^{2}\sum_{i<2m}\sum_{i'<i}(1-x)^{i'}$ at the telescope, and
$2m\,x=2\,|\Phi|\,[\,s:n\,]$ at $|\Phi|\le([\,L:2\,]+\varepsilon)\,D$.
\emph{The near mass.} At the \emph{complement read}
$u_p:=(2d_L-\delta_p)\,[\,1:2d_L\,]$, a positive element
with $1-u_p$ positive and flat read one, and a natural $k$, the
\emph{return read} $Q:=\prod_pu_p^{2k}$ is a positive element
below one, the gap $\sum_p(1-u_p^{2k})\prod_{q<p}u_q^{2k}$ at the
product's telescope, with flat read one and support weight $W_k$
at or below $c_W\,k^{e}$ at the support exponent $e$ and the
support coefficient $c_W$ (Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}): a
plaquette character's power reads labels at fusion depth at most
its degree on the plaquette's links, the link's plaquettes' powers
fuse at the link to depth at most $4gk$, the grade key moves by at
most two per fusion (the move cap, Lemma~\ref{lem:contactdrift}), and
per key the labels and dimensions sit at or below $A\,(\mathcal G+1)^{\wp}$
(the counts, Lemma~\ref{lem:contactdrift}), so a
link's occupied dimensions' squares fold to at most
$A^{3}(8gk+1)^{3\wp+1}$ and the weight to at most that power's
$\#\ell$-th, at $8gk+1\le9gk$. So $\mathrm{Eval}(Q)$ sits at or
beyond $[\,1:W_k\,]$, the flat read's square against the support
weight (Construction~\ref{con:coeff}). Per plaquette the reads
$b_i:=\mathrm{Eval}\big(u_p^{2i}\prod_{q\ne p}u_q^{2k}\big)$ fall at
a slowing rate: $b_0\le1$, $b_k=\mathrm{Eval}(Q)$,
$b_i^{2}\le b_{i-1}\,b_{i+1}$ (the evaluation's squared
Cauchy--Schwarz at the positive element
$\prod_{q\ne p}u_q^{2k}$), and $b_{i+1}\le b_i$ at
$(1-u_p^{2})\,u_p^{2i}$ positive, so the \emph{step quotients} $r_i$
at $r_i\,b_i=b_{i+1}$ ascend below one and $b_k$ sits at or below
$r_{k-1}^{\,k}$: at a step quotient's gap $y$ at $r_{k-1}+y=1$
beyond a pair $\tau$ the far read's Bernstein bound at the natural
$j:=e+1$, $C(k,j)\,y^{j}\,r_{k-1}^{\,k}\le1$, reads
$C(k,j)\,\tau^{j}<W_k$ at $\tau^{j}<y^{j}$, against
$C(k,j)\,j^{j}\ge k^{j}$ at $k\ge j$ and $W_k\le c_Wk^{e}$, so
$k\,\tau^{\,j}<c_W\,j^{\,j}$ at $j=e+1$, against the concentration
key's comparison $k\,\tau^{\,j}\ge c_W\,j^{\,j}$ at $k(\tau)$
(Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}) and at every $k$ beyond it, so
the gap sits at or below $\tau$, and the deficit's read at the
return read,
$\delta_p\,Q=2d_L\,(1-u_p)\,u_p^{2k}\prod_{q\ne p}u_q^{2k}$ at
$(1-u_p)\,u_p^{2k}\le(1-u_p^{2})\,u_p^{2k}$, sits at or below
$2d_L\,(b_k-b_{k+1})\le2d_L\,\tau\,\mathrm{Eval}(Q)$ at
$k+1$ at or beyond the key, the raised member
$u_p^{2k+2}\prod_{q\ne p}u_q^{2k}$ fusing at $p$'s links to depth at
most $4gk+2$, its key at most $8gk+5$, at or below $9gk$ from $k$ at or
beyond five, the concentration key at or beyond $e+1$ and $e$ at or
beyond four at the window's four links or more, so its evaluation
sits at or beyond $[\,1:c_W\,k^{e}\,]$ as $\mathrm{Eval}(Q)$ does. The
trial's mass then reads at the
near read against the return read, $\Psi^{2}\ge\Psi^{2}Q\ge(1-2mx)\,Q$
at $1-Q$ positive, the exponent's read against the deficits' fold
and the fold's read against the return read:
\begin{gather*}
\mu[1]\ \ge\ \mathrm{Eval}(Q)\,\Big(1-2\,[\,s:n\,]\,([\,L:2\,]+\varepsilon)\,
\#p\,2d_L\,\tau\Big)\ \ge\ [\,1:2\,]\,\mathrm{Eval}(Q)\ \ge\ [\,1:2\,W_{k}\,]\\
\ge\ \vartheta
\end{gather*}
at the stated pair $\tau$ and the concentration key $k=k(\tau)$, the
near mass $\vartheta$ (Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}).
\emph{The near scale.} At a weight $P$ at the pairs $(P_+,P_-)$ and a
natural $k$ the deficits' fold reads its
$k$-th power against a weight at the \emph{near scale} $K$: at
$y:=D\,[\,1:K\eta\,]$ and a natural $j'$,
\[
y^{k}\ \le\ 1+y^{k+j'}\ ,
\qquad
\mu\big[P\,D^{k}\big]\ \le\ (K\eta)^{k}\,\mu[P]
+\mu\big[P\,D^{k+j'}\big]\,[\,1:(K\eta)^{j'}\,]
\ \le\ 2\,(K\eta)^{k}\,\mu[P]\ ,
\]
the first at the gap $(1-y)^{2}\big(\sum_{i<k}y^{i}\big)
\big(\sum_{i<j'}y^{i}\big)+y^{j'}$, the second its moment against
$P\,(K\eta)^{k}$, and the third at the far read,
$\mu[P\,D^{k+j'}]\le(k+j')!\,\eta^{k+j'}\,[\,1:\varepsilon^{k+j'}\,]\,P_+$,
against $(K\eta)^{k}P_-$ at $m\ge k+j'$, the exponent count's read:
at the bit count $j'$ (Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}) and a near
scale at or beyond $[\,2\,k!\,(k+j'):\varepsilon\,]$ the comparison
$K^{j'}\varepsilon^{k+j'}P_-\ge(k+j')!\,P_+$ holds at
$(k+j')!\le(k+j')^{j'}\,k!$; the stated weight pairs are the unit's, the
mode square's and its square's (a weight's square a weight at the
squared pair, Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}), the powers at or
below four, and the bit count is the largest
over them (the lower powers at $\varepsilon\le1$), so the stated near
scale $K=[\,48\,(4+j'):\varepsilon\,]$ reads every weight at every
power at or below four ($2\,k!\,(k+j')$ at or below $48\,(4+j')$ at
every power $k$ at or below four, the comparison monotone in the
near scale).
\end{proof}
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[The moment identities]\label{lem:cornermoments}
At the corner trial (Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}) and the
window's data (Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}): \emph{(i) the
cross read at a moved coordinate}, at a range vector $u'$ and a link
$\ell$,
\begin{gather*}
\sum_aX^{\ell}_a\big(R_{\ell\leftarrow0}\,y_{u'}\big)_a
\;=\;\big\langle\,r_\ell\;:\;\kappa_\Sigma\dim G\,(K^{\mathsf T}u')_\ell\,\big\rangle\ ,\\
|r_\ell|\ \le\ \varrho_1\,|u'|_\infty\,D\ ,
\qquad
\varrho_1:=C_2^{+}+m_L\,(1+2\,t_L\,g^{2}L)\ ;
\end{gather*}
\emph{(ii) the coordinate identity}, at range vectors $u$, $u'$ and
an involution-fixed positive element $Z$,
\begin{multline*}
2\,[\,s:n\,]\,\nu\big[\,Z\,\langle y_{u'},y_u\rangle\,\big]
+\sum_\ell c^{(u)}_\ell\,\mu\big[\,Z\,r_\ell\,\big]\\
+\sum_\ell c^{(u)}_\ell\,\mu\big[\,\langle R_{\ell\leftarrow0}y_{u'},\,X^{\ell}Z\rangle\,\big]
+2\,[\,s:n\,]\sum_\ell c^{(u)}_\ell\,
\nu\big[\,Z\,\langle R_{\ell\leftarrow0}y_{u'},\,R_\ell\rangle\,\big]\\
=\;\kappa_\Sigma\dim G\ u'^{\mathsf T}(\mathsf S+\varepsilon)^{-1}u\ \mu[Z]\ ;
\end{multline*}
and \emph{(iii) the deficit cell}: at the near scale $K$
(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornernear}) and the two comparisons at the scale
\[
2\,\#p\,\eta\,C_1\varrho_1\ \le\ \kappa_\Sigma\ ,
\qquad
\eta\,K^{2}\,\big(8\,[\,1:\kappa_\Sigma\,]\,C_1^{2}T_R^{2}
+4\,[\,1:\kappa_\Sigma\,]\,c_{\mathrm{off}}+4\,c'_q\big)\ \le\ 1
\]
at $c'_q:=[\,s_L:2\,]$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:loopcap}'s
second-order pair) and $c_{\mathrm{off}}$ the cubes' boundaries'
fold (Construction~\ref{con:cornerwindow}), the deficits' fold reads
\[
\mu[D]\ \le\ C_D\,\#p\,\eta\ \mu[1]\ ,\qquad
C_D:=2\,\dim G\,W_0+1\ ,
\]
$C_D$ a member pair in the direction count, free of the side, the
mass and the near scale.
\begin{proof}

\big(G_{\ell}+\varepsilon F_{\ell}\big)=y_u$ at

and read a further vector's incidence fold to the shifted kernel's

=u'^{\mathsf T}(\mathsf S+\varepsilon)^{-1}u$. A generator at a link
reads the moved coordinate's trace at the cross read
(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornercert}(ii)),
$\sum_aX^{\ell}_a(R_{\ell\leftarrow0}f_p)_a
=K_{p\ell}\,\langle\mathrm{dev}_{\ell p}\!:\!\chi'_p\rangle$ at

=\;\kappa_\Sigma\dim G\ u'^{\mathsf T}(\mathsf S+\varepsilon)^{-1}u\ \mu[Z]\ ,

the left member's first summand the exponent's gradient read back

\begin{lemma}[The excess]\label{lem:cornerexcess}

\begin{lemma}[The mode member]\label{lem:cornermode}

+64\,W_0^{8}C_W^{4}T_R^{4}K^{4}\eta^{2}\ \le\ [\,1:1024\,]\,\kappa_\Sigma^{2}\sigma_-^{2}\ ,\\

\qquad

(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornernear}): \emph{(i) the
mode identities}, the coordinate identity
(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornermoments}) at $Z=1$ and at $Z=Q$ at

at $X^{\ell}_a(R_{\ell\leftarrow0}y_W)_b$ the pair

and $|r_2|\le[\,3:16\,]\,\kappa_\Sigma\sigma_W\,\mu[Q]$, and so do the

\begin{lemma}[The mode read]\label{lem:cornermoderead}
The \emph{mode read} $r_v$ is the mode member's read against the
floor line, $r_v\,\langle v,v\rangle$ the pencil's form at $v$ less
the floor line's multiple of the gram (Lemma~\ref{lem:cornercert};
Lemma~\ref{lem:cornermode}). On the deficit cell
(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornermoments}) and the remainder cell at
$\eta\,(\dim G+2)\le1$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:cornermode}), at the near
reads (Lemma~\ref{lem:cornernear}) and the trial's factor display
(Construction~\ref{con:cornertrial}),
\begin{gather*}
r_v\ \le\ 16\,\kappa_\Sigma\,(L+2)\,e_W\ \eta
+384\,g\,\kappa_\Sigma\,C_Z\ \varepsilon^{2}\,\eta+P_v\,\eta^{2}\ ,\\
C_Z:=2\,\dim G\,W_0\,\#p+8\,W_0^{2}\,(L+2)\ ,\\
P_v:=32\,K\,\varrho_2\,\#\ell\,(L+2)
+(384\,g\,\kappa_\Sigma+6+\Omega)\,P'+(6+\Omega)\,C_Z\\
+(96\,\Theta_R+4\,c_q)\,(1+2\dim G)\,K^{2}+W_q\ ,\\
P':=[\,32:\kappa_\Sigma\,]\,\#p\,C_1^{2}T_R^{2}K^{2}(1+2\dim G)
+[\,26:\kappa_\Sigma^{2}\,]\,\#p\,C_1^{2}\varrho_2\,(L+2)\,K\\
+26\,W_0^{2}(L+2)\,K+4\,(1+2\dim G)\\
+\big(8\,c_{\mathrm{off}}[\,1:\kappa_\Sigma\,]+8\,c'_q\big)K^{2}(1+2\dim G)\ ,
\end{gather*}
$C_Z$ in the side and the direction count, $P'$ and $P_v$ in the
side, the direction count and the near scale, all free of the mass,
the leading read the mode's own frequency read at the profile's
Gram against its self-pairing.
\begin{proof}
The member's form against the floor line reads the squares and the slack at $v$,
$T(\langle Q\!:\!\bar q\rangle\Psi)=\eta\,(XQ)\,\Psi+\langle Q\!:\!\bar q\rangle\,T\Psi$, so
\begin{gather*}
\langle v,(H-\ell_0)\,v\rangle\ \le\
2\,\eta^{2}\,\mu\big[|XQ|^{2}\big]+2\,\mu\big[\langle Q\!:\!\bar q\rangle^{2}\,t(D)\big]
+\mu\big[\langle Q\!:\!\bar q\rangle^{2}\,q\big]\ ,\\
\mu\big[|XQ|^{2}\big]\le8\,\kappa_\Sigma^{\,2}\,e_W\,|W|^{2}\,\mu[Q]
+8\,\varrho_2\,\#\ell\,|W|_\infty^{2}\,\mu[QD]\ ,
\end{gather*}
$t(D)$ the squares' cap and $q$ the slack
(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornerexcess}), $|XQ|^{2}$ the fold of
$2\,\langle X^{\ell}(R_{\ell\leftarrow0}y_W),\,R_{\ell\leftarrow0}y_W\rangle$'s
squares at the leading member $W^{\mathsf T}\Delta W=e_W|W|^{2}$, the
mode read at the closed sums, and the mode square's deficit moment
$\mu[QD]\le2K\eta\,\mu[Q]$ at the near scale
(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornernear}). \emph{The mode weight's moments.} At the \emph{mode weight}

\[

\begin{construction}[The sector's tail certificate]\label{con:sectorcert}
At a member, a direction count and a window of the directed family
(Definition~\ref{def:carrier}), the vacuum sector's \emph{tail
certificate} on a scale segment is the data reading, at every
scale of the segment and every fiber (Lemma~\ref{lem:fiberdec}),
the sector's decimated head's count at a stated line one at the
unit fiber and the sum's unit at a further fiber
(Theorem~\ref{thm:decimation}; Lemma~\ref{lem:inertia}), the line
above the ground by a stated positive pair at the scale, the
\emph{lines' gap}, so that the corner floor at every ray of the
segment sits at or beyond the pair; its reads are five. \emph{(i)
The scale's read.} At one scale the count at the line is one
finite read: the labels whose diagonal at the line clears their
off-row magnitude fold are the \emph{dominant tail}
(Theorem~\ref{thm:decimation}(ii)), the tail's form at or beyond
its \emph{gaps'} fold of squares at every cutoff, the gap the
diagonal less the fold, so the chain's count at the line at every
cutoff sits at or below the count of the \emph{floored head}, the head's pencil less the tail coupling's solve at the gaps' diagonal, every gap beyond the sum's unit (the dominance read's kernel block vacant there, Theorem~\ref{thm:decimation}(ii)),
$Z_H-B\,\mathrm{diag}(g)^{-1}B^{\mathsf T}$ at the coupling $B$ and
the gaps $g$: the tail's form joined to the coupling's cross read
sits at or beyond the balance partner of the solve's form at every
tail vector, the completed square at the gaps, so the full pencil's
form at or beyond the floored head's at every vector and the counts
monotone (Lemma~\ref{lem:inertia}); the floored head is a finite
symmetric pencil at the scale and the line, one split, cutoff-free.
\emph{(ii) The comparison read.} At two regional records,
let $Z,\widetilde Z$ be the reduced site data at their stated
lines, on a common list of positive Gram $G$ through the
records' specified congruences. A transport at width $\rho$
has the two-sided cap and the two margin counts
\[
Z-\rho G\preceq\widetilde Z\preceq Z+\rho G,
\qquad
\operatorname{rev}(Z+\rho G)=q=\operatorname{rev}(Z:\rho G).
\]
Inertia gives
$q\le\operatorname{rev}\widetilde Z\le q$,
so the reduced counts agree (Lemma~\ref{lem:inertia}).
Each original count joins its record's dropped-pivot counts
to this read (Theorem~\ref{thm:decimation}(i)). A spectator
comparison includes the slab families' equal-entry or
diagonal-tie identities and their transfer certificates
(Lemma~\ref{lem:spectator}(i),(ii)); its width enters the
displayed margin counts at the actual site data. A
\emph{reach} includes these reads at every comparison
beyond its stated bound. \emph{(iii) The
tail's read.} The count at the line is a split's lower-side count
(Lemma~\ref{lem:inertia}), and the certificate over the segment is
the \emph{split family}: at every scale of the segment the splits at
the line of the actual regional records' floored heads ((i)),
a reduction through finitely many window shapes including
(ii)'s reads at every transport. The heads' entries are one polynomial-pair
list in the chord and the scale (Lemma~\ref{lem:contactcell};
Lemma~\ref{lem:dualtrunc}), the family closing in finitely many
displayed comparisons over the segment, each a polynomial comparison
in the scale and the head's data on a stated box with its validity
divisors located (Lemma~\ref{lem:cellcount};
Theorem~\ref{thm:windowsep}). At a chain whose shells beyond the
collar are blocks of one stated order the family is the block
chain's certificate (Lemma~\ref{lem:cornerblock}), the band-one walk
at the single-plaquette window its scalar instance
(Lemma~\ref{lem:cornerpivot}). At a chain whose shells grow with the
depth the certificate's data are a \emph{profile} $u$, positive

\begin{construction}[The depth chain of a window]\label{con:depthchain}
On a window (Definition~\ref{def:carrier}) the \emph{fusion graph}
joins two members of the window index, each with its fiber, where
a plaquette's term reads a state of the one against a state of the
other off the sum's unit (Theorem~\ref{thm:pairpencil}'s magnetic
member; Definition~\ref{def:algebra}'s changed-edge read), a
symmetric relation at the term's symmetry, the unit's line one
member, the graph over the region's whole index, every content at
once; a \emph{sector} is a base's fusion closure, the members the
walk from the base reaches, one component of the graph, the unit's
line's closure the \emph{vacuum sector}; a member's \emph{depth} is
its distance from the base along the graph, the least count of
joined steps, one natural per member, a member joined to one at
depth $d$ sitting at depth at most $d+1$; and the \emph{shells} are
the members at one depth, finitely many: a member at depth $d$
has its support within $d$ plaquettes' links of the base's and its
contents within the attained maximum $\Phi$ iterated $d$ times from
the base's against the closure's four-link contents
(Proposition~\ref{prop:fusionfinite}'s $\Phi$;
Proposition~\ref{prop:algebra}), one bound per depth
(Proposition~\ref{prop:windowfinite}), the occupied depths the counts
from the base's up, a member first reached at a count joined to a
member first reached at the count before. \emph{The sectors are the
charges.} Two occupied configurations of one \emph{charge}, the
fluxes of their class families through the transverse cuts one
class per direction (Construction~\ref{con:lattice}'s boundary
read at the vertex law of an occupied vertex, the incident labels'
classes folding to the unit), sit in one sector: the two class
families differ by a cycle at unit fluxes, a boundary fold of plaquettes at class
coefficients (Construction~\ref{con:lattice}'s boundary read), and
the walk from the one reaches the other at those plaquettes: per
plaquette the coefficient's class is a fold of the list's classes
(Construction~\ref{con:fusion}), read as a product of the
plaquette's closure characters, and per link of the target the
target's label sits in the product of the source's label with the
plaquette characters' labels around the link, every label at some
depth of the closure's fusion from the unit (the \emph{reach read}
below), the further factors joined in dual pairs at the unit
channel (Proposition~\ref{prop:repring}); and one plaquette term
joins a configuration to every admissible target: the term's read
at a source state composes the state's vertex members at the
boundary's four vertices with the loop's coevaluation, the loop's
coefficient contracted at each vertex (Definition~\ref{def:algebra}'s
changed-edge read), and its component at a target whose boundary
labels are constituents of the source's labels against the member
is the coevaluation's channel split at every boundary link
(Lemma~\ref{lem:dualread}(i); the pair networks' split,
Theorem~\ref{thm:network}(ii)), each channel at the weight
$[\,m_bd_b:d_ad_\lambda\,]$, a summand of the dimension identity
(Lemma~\ref{lem:blockcount}(ii)), positive, so the component is
occupied at every admissible target; the target's labels are
reached along the associativity's occupied summands, each link's
chain of channels at positive counts (Lemma~\ref{lem:blockcount}(iii)),
one plaquette term per step, so a walk joins the two. \emph{The
reach read}: every label sits in a product of the closure's
members. Every label is a Cartan product of fundamentals at its
fundamental fold, one at every step (Construction~\ref{con:fusion}'s
Cartan strictness), and every fundamental sits in a product of the
closure's members at the member's reach list
(Construction~\ref{con:memtable}) seeded at the list: at the
$A$-series the fundamentals are the column exhibits, $\omega_k$ in
the fundamental's $k$-th power (Lemma~\ref{lem:tops}(iii)); at
$C_\ell$ the reach list runs from the first fundamental, the list's
own; at $B_\ell$ the vector sits in the spinor's square and at
$D_\ell$ in the spinor's square at odd rank, the spinor's class of
order four reading the vector's at its double, the minuscule rows
(Lemma~\ref{lem:serstable}(ii)), and is a list member at even
rank, the reach list then running from the vector; at $E_6$, $E_7$
and $E_8$ the reach list's seeds are the list's members; at $F_4$
the reach list's seed $\omega_1$ sits in the list member's square,
one stated count of the member's table (the uniqueness read,
Construction~\ref{con:memtable}), and at $G_2$ the reach list runs
from the list. So at a faithful list the sectors are one per
charge, the vacuum sector the unit charge's; at a further list the
vacuum sector is the unit label's closure, one component among the
charge's. The
\emph{depth chain} is the sector's pencil at the shells, the

contents (Definition~\ref{def:carrier}; Definition~\ref{def:pencil};
Theorem~\ref{thm:pairpencil}), so their blocks are the shells' own
